adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy, the function returns a `fetch(...)` Response object. In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenInfo` is assigned from `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then used like an Axios response (`if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`). On the sync path, `tokenInfo.data` will be `undefined` (Fetch Response has no `.data`), causing broken refresh behavior. This is directly introduced by the diff.
